title: Assessment System Metadata (self-contained per-annual sidecar) v2
description: One file describes exactly one (jurisdiction x assessment_system x year). v2 (ADR-008/ADR-009) adds: the enrollment-grade model on every content area (intended_enrollment_grade fixed|variable + enrolled_grades_tested — disentangling the instrument's target grade, the student's enrolled grade, and cut keys), scale_bounds (loss/hoss keyed by enrolled grade, mirroring cutscores), a canonical assessment_type enum with conditional measurement.elp / measurement.alternate extension blocks, source_documents[], and per-grade cutscores_source confidence. AXIS RULE: cutscores, scale_bounds, and cutscores_source are ALWAYS keyed by ENROLLED grade — never by instrument or form name; instrument forms (e.g. WIDA grade clusters) are measurement facts in the extension blocks. v1 records remain valid during the migration window (ADR-009 D6).

schema_version.description: Canonical v2 identifier. Supersedes amr.assessment_system.v1 (and the sgpc.assessment_metadata.v0.1 alias), which remain accepted by the validator during the migration window.

status.description: Governance status. draft = unreviewed (incl. machine-drafted or placeholder values); reviewed = a human checked it; verified = confirmed against an authoritative citation; deprecated = retained for history but superseded. Colleague verification-state map: unverified->draft, auto_derived->draft(+low), in_review->reviewed, human_verified->verified.

source_confidence.description: Confidence in the substantive facts (esp. cutscores/levels/bounds). Placeholder/scaffold values are low. Per-value confidence lives on scale_bounds entries (source) and cutscores_source.

provenance.description: Where this record came from, who entered it, and what changed. Required (with source_citation) for any status other than draft.

source_citation.description: URL or document reference for the authoritative source of the substantive claims (the primary citation; additional evidence goes in source_documents).

entered_by.description: Author identifier; for machine-drafted records use the form ai:<harness-id>.

verified_by.description: Who performed the last verification (reviewer identifier), or null if unverified. Pairs with last_verified_at (ADR-010, adopted from the colleague spec's provenance).

changed_from_prior.description: What changed vs the prior year/commit and why (assessment-system change vs metadata correction vs modeling decision).

source_documents.description: Evidence list beyond the primary provenance.source_citation: technical manuals, interpretive guides, state memos. url may be null when a document is known but not yet located online (ADR-009 D4).

type.description: state/territory/consortium/district are sub-national census frames. nation is a national frame (e.g. the United States for NAEP, id US). international is a cross-national frame (e.g. IEA for a TIMSS cycle, id INTL). benchmarking-entity is a sub-national participant that carries its own administration (ADR-013 D1). other remains the residual.

assessment_type.description: Canonical discriminator (ADR-008 SS5). Legacy v1 strings (state-summative, english-language-proficiency, general) are normalized by migrate_registry(). elp permits measurement.elp; alternate permits measurement.alternate. national-sample and international-sample (ADR-013) gate consumption: there is no student-level score column — a score is a set of plausible values and a marginal is weighted — so a consumer reads design before touching a value. The type says that the assessment is sampled; design says how.

cutscores_provenance.description: Free-text note about the provenance/status of the cutscores/scale_bounds blocks specifically (e.g. a PLACEHOLDER warning). Complements the structured provenance block and per-grade cutscores_source.

comparability.description: Year-resolved comparability of this administration to the prior year: scale breaks, vendor/blueprint changes, and administration gaps (e.g. COVID-19).

enrollment.description: The enrollment-grade model (ADR-009 D1): the relationship between this instrument and the ENROLLED grade of the student taking it. fixed = the instrument targets one enrolled grade (ILEARN Grade 8 Math); variable = students from multiple enrolled grades sit the same instrument (ACT; WIDA grade-span forms).

enrolled_grades_tested.description: Ordered enrolled grades that sit this content area. K (and PK) permitted. EOC without a grade association may use [] with an explanatory note.

note.description: Free text for the murky edge cases (e.g. 'ACT is a high-school test usually administered to 11th graders but taken by 10th/12th for graduation-competency purposes').

proficient_from.description: Canonical proficiency benchmark (ADR-010): the label (one of labels[]) of the LOWEST level counted as proficient. A single value that is robust to label edits and cleanly separates the measurement fact (the levels exist) from the policy fact (where proficiency begins). Consumers derive the boolean mask from it. Preferred over the legacy proficient[] mask; the validator checks it names a real label.
proficient_from.$comment: Membership in labels[] is enforced by the R validator, not the schema.

proficient.description: DEPRECATED (ADR-010): legacy boolean mask aligned positionally to labels[]. Superseded by proficient_from (a single label), which avoids positional coupling and the non-monotonic masks the array form permits. Still accepted during migration; when both are present the validator checks they agree.

cutscores.description: content_area -> ENROLLED grade -> strictly increasing level lower bounds (count = n_levels - 1). Grade keys are enrolled grades, never instrument/form names (axis rule). EXCEPTION (ADR-010): an end-of-course assessment, whose standard is instrument-level rather than grade-specific, may use the single sentinel key "eoc" in place of enrolled grades — write the cut once instead of copying it across every enrolled grade. Permitted by the validator only when assessment_type = end-of-course.

cutscores_source.description: Optional per-grade confidence for cutscore vectors: content_area -> enrolled grade -> official|derived|provisional (ADR-008 SS5 per-value confidence).

scale_bounds.description: content_area -> ENROLLED grade -> scale envelope {loss, hoss, source?}. Mirrors cutscores keying exactly (ADR-009 D2), including the end-of-course "eoc" sentinel key (ADR-010); per-grade because scales may differ by grade (ILEARN); uniform scales simply repeat values. Invariant (validator): loss <= min(cuts) <= max(cuts) <= hoss where both blocks are present.

measurement.description: Type-conditional measurement extension blocks (ADR-009 D3). Vendor/psychometric facts ONLY — policy facts (ELP exit, growth targets, timelines, participation rules) live in the accountability record (ADR-002 heuristic).

elp.description: English-language-proficiency measurement facts (permitted only when assessment_type = elp).

composites.description: Composite score definitions keyed by composite id (which may match a content_areas[].id, e.g. ELP_COMPOSITE): label + domain weights.

grade_clusters.description: Instrument FORM spans (e.g. K, 1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-8, 9-12). These are forms, not score-interpretation keys — cuts and bounds are keyed by enrolled grade (axis rule).

alternate.description: Alternate-assessment measurement facts (permitted only when assessment_type = alternate). Participation criteria and the federal 1% cap are POLICY facts -> accountability record.

aliases.description: Crosswalks: canonical id -> alternate names/codes (old names, SGP content-area names, colleague 'subjects' names, state abbreviations).

edfi.description: Optional Ed-Fi descriptor crosswalk overrides for this cell.

design.description: Optional sampling-design semantics the engine reads and an ingest cannot discover (ADR-013 D2). Orthogonal to assessment_type: a state census file may carry a trivial design, and a future state assessment reported with plausible values would use this block without becoming a sample assessment. student_sampling names whether the marginal is a census or a weighted sample; matrix (booklet) item sampling is an item-design fact that belongs in notes.

student_sampling.description: Whether the reported marginal is a census or a weighted sample. Does not encode booklet/matrix item sampling.

scoring_model.description: How a student score is produced. Default scale. design.plausible_values.count >= 1 requires scale (validator D3.3).

plausible_values.description: Plausible-value draws on the reported scale. variable_prefix is a string (one prefix for the administration, e.g. NAEP MRPCM) or a map keyed by content area then enrolled grade (e.g. TIMSS ASMMAT/BSMMAT, ASSSCI/BSSSCI).

count.description: Number of plausible-value draws per student.

variable_prefix.description: A string prefix, or a map of content-area id -> enrolled-grade -> prefix.

weights.description: Full-sample weight variable and the replicate-weight variance rule.

full_sample_variable.description: Name of the full-sample weight column (e.g. ORIGWT, TOTWGT).

replicate.description: Replicate-weight variance rule. zones, replicates, and variance_factor are required under every method. replicates is zones or 2*zones, with variance_factor 1 or 0.5 matching (validator D3.4). JK1/BRR use variable_prefix; JK2 uses zone_variable + rep_variable.

method.description: Jackknife 1, jackknife 2, or balanced repeated replication.

replicates.description: Number of replicate weights. Equal to zones (factor 1) or 2*zones (factor 0.5).

variance_factor.description: Multiplier on the sum of squared replicate deviations (NAEP 1; TIMSS 2003-2011 1; TIMSS 2015+ 0.5). Validator restricts to {1, 0.5} matching replicates vs zones.

variable_prefix.description: JK1/BRR: replicate-weight column prefix (e.g. SRWT). Forbidden under JK2.

cycle_years.description: Calendar years the cycle was administered in. A TIMSS cycle can span two years (southern-hemisphere systems test in the preceding autumn). Must include administration.year (validator D3.5). A single-year cycle repeats administration.year.

longitudinal_link.description: When this administration is a follow-up wave, the linked base administration in the corpus (validator D3.6: linked_administration_id must be an administration.id already present; span_years >= 1).

linked_administration_id.description: administration.id of the linked (usually prior) wave.

span_years.description: Years between the linked administration and this one.

notes.description: Booklet/matrix design and other facts the engine does not consume.

Optional free-text interpretive note for this administration (how to read the metadata; policy caveats). Distinct from provenance.source_citation and cutscores_provenance (source/citation). A note may also attach per content_area, achievement_levels entry, and scale_bounds cell.
